Rate, spread, SOFR, maturity date and percent on the three rows match the printed lines (12.63/12.63/14.31; 7.00/7.00/8.75; 2027-08-10/2027-08-10/2027-07-08; 6.6/6.3/8.5), but the observation marks 'fixed' while noting maturity_status 'unresolved' as 'not investigated'. Investigated here: it is a published error on 3 rows, in maturity_status and maturity_precision, not in maturity_date. pipeline/financial_conventions.py sets precision_value 'day' only when maturity_date_source is xbrl_field or nport (line 264), so printed_page gives maturity_precision 'unknown' and then maturity_status 'unresolved' (line 313). The page prints a full MM/DD/YY date, so the right values are 'day' / 'dated'. Effect: maturity_interval_sql returns NULL bounds for unknown precision, so the matcher's maturity veto is off for these rows, and anything that filters maturity_status = 'dated' drops them. The frontend shows the full date (it only truncates month/year precision), so it shows nothing wrong. No detector catches it (financial_validation's status/precision consistency rules do not test 'unresolved' with a valid date). The existing_detector reference X02/F23 does not cover this residual. Needed: printed_page added to the day-precision sources (with a test), or a recorded owner decision that page dates stay 'unresolved'.
